svg.title: Spring Fairy Garden — step 3: Add a light roof
svg.desc: Lay small pieces of loose fallen bark or broad leaves across the leaning twigs. Work from the bottom upwards so each layer overlaps the one below. Keep the doorway open and the roof light. Use a light twig to hold a slipping leaf instead of adding heavy pieces.
